text: Anthropic released Claude 4 as two distinct models, Opus 4 and Sonnet 4, on May 8, 2025 [Source: ev-1]. The launch signaled that Anthropic was positioning itself as the leader in the agentic-coding market by offering a tiered approach to meet different developer needs [Source: ev-1]. Specifically, Opus 4 served as the flagship model ("Claude 4") priced at $15 per million input tokens and $75 per million output tokens, while Sonnet 4 acted as the fast workhorse and "developer-default coding model" with lower pricing of $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens [Source: ev-1]. This strategy proved successful, contributing to record API usage and helping cement Anthropic’s position as the coding-agent leader, which later supported a funding round at a reported valuation of approximately $183 billion in late September 2025 [Source: ev-1].
